text:
alex_w: FYI customer's seeing p99 spikes (~2.9s -> 6.8s) when using function-calling with structured output validators. Raising here to triage.

support_sara: which customer + route? any repro steps / sample payload?

alex_w: ACME / models/text-dedicated-2; route POST /v1/generate/func-call. snippet:
```json
{ "model": "text-dedicated-2", "input": "summarize...", "functions": [{"name": "create_ticket","parameters": {"type": "object","properties": {"summary": {"type": "string"}, "metadata": {"type": "object"}}}}], "function_call": "auto" }
```
latency graph: p95 800ms -> 1.2s, p99 2.9s -> 6.8s after deploy 2026-03-12

jamal_k: can you share CPU profiles or flamegraph? my hunch: JSON schema validator running synchronously per-candidate output round. If validator is compiled per-request that'd explain regression.

sre_bot: Incident INC-3088 created: ticket #INC-3088, paging oncall.

support_sara: repro steps I ran quickly:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/func-call \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d @payload.json
```
payload is the snippet above. p99 reproduced locally on dev cluster (6.5s). logs show spikes in /router/validate.json

maria_g: check runtime logs for message "validator.compile()" calls. If we compile for each request instead of using compiled-schema cache it's expensive. Also schema complexity (nested objects + enums) multiplies cost.

alex_w: logs:
```
[2026-03-12T14:05:02Z] router: validate start for request id=abcd
[2026-03-12T14:05:02Z] validator.compile time=120ms
[2026-03-12T14:05:02Z] validator.validate time=3200ms
```

jamal_k: actionable mitigations: 1) temporary: disable strict structured validation for affected customer via route header `X-Structured-Validation: off` or console toggle. 2) enable compiled-schema cache (config `validator_cache.enabled=true`, `validator_cache.size=1024`). 3) run async validation post-response for non-blocking cases. 4) short-term fallback: route to model variant without function-calling.

ingrid: instructions to toggle from Console -> Routes -> Route ID -> Advanced -> Structured validation: Off. For API patch:
```
PATCH /v1/routes/route-ACME-123
{ "structured_validation": false }
```

Note: this will avoid rejecting responses but keep lower latency.

jamal_k: deploying quick hotfix: PR #4021 adds compiled-schema cache + metrics (validator.compile_ms histogram). rolling to canary now.

support_sara: applied console toggle for ACME at 2026-03-12T15:02:00Z. Customer confirms p99 back to ~800ms. They're OK with mitigation while we complete fix.

maria_g: next steps: add unit test for schema-heavy function outputs to our perf suite, emit telemetry for validator.compile per-route, and expose a per-route config to choose sync vs async validation.

alex_w: noted. Creating follow-up ticket: PERF-1279 (add cache + telemetry) and will update ACME. Thanks all :heart:

jamal_k: :thumbsup: will keep canary running and post memory/CPU numbers once stable.

sre_bot: INC-3088 resolved (mitigated) 2026-03-12T16:10:00Z

support_sara: closing loop with customer and marking as escalated->engineering. Will paste customer ack when received.

alex_w: Thanks everyone.
